arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Goal fastest finish. 1) Let start settle; hold shaft ~190 W (pod CP 187 W + reserve 19.5 kJ spread over race), a touch harder into current legs, easier with it. 2) Check calibration from heart rate: at steady effort HR should level if below true CP, keep climbing if above. Use measure() over steady stretches per leg pair; adjust critical_power beliefs if evidence clear. 3) Watch for incidents: weed (speed drops mid-leg at same pod power -> clear_rudder), pod drift (pod power moves while HR and speed do not -> set pod_gain), radio course change (set_race_distance + tell), wind shift. 4) Finish: spend remaining reserve in final ~1-1.5 km (finish cue when reserve allows).
